login.title: Log in
login.pasif: Please complete your payment. Your account is inactive until payment is received.
login.onayBekliyor: Your account is awaiting approval. You can log in once it is approved.
login.musteriPanel: This panel is for businesses. Customers use the mobile app.

landing.heroText: Manage your shops, stylists and services from one panel. Your customers pick a city and district in the mobile app and book an appointment.
landing.feature1Text: Customers see free slots and book their own appointment. You control confirmations and cancellations.
landing.feature2Text: Each stylist has their own services, working hours and time off.
landing.feature3Text: Monthly appointment and revenue summaries, and customer ratings for each stylist.
landing.paymentNote: Paid plans are paid by bank transfer. Your account is activated after the payment is checked.
landing.topText: Sorted by the average rating given by customers. Only stylists with at least 3 reviews are listed.
landing.citiesText: The best stylists in each city, ranked by customer ratings.
landing.plansText: Choose the plan that fits your business.
landing.ctaText: Open your account, add your shop and set up your stylists. Your customers book appointments in the mobile app.
landing.reviewsText: The latest reviews from customers who completed an appointment.
landing.slide1Eyebrow: Booking platform for salons and barbers
landing.slide1Text: Manage your shops, stylists and services from one panel. Your customers pick a city and district in the mobile app and book an appointment.
landing.slide2Title: Let your free slots fill themselves
landing.slide2Text: Customers pick the shop, stylist, service and free time in the mobile app. You decide whether to confirm.
landing.slide3Title: Your whole salon on one screen
landing.slide3Text: Working hours, time off, appointments and monthly summaries in one place. Start with one shop and add more as you grow.
landing.aboutTitle: Move your appointment book to the phone
landing.aboutText: Instead of writing phone bookings in a notebook, run your salon from one panel. Each stylist has their own services and working hours, and customers only see times that are really free.
landing.aboutPoint1: Customers find you by choosing a city and district.
landing.aboutPoint2: A slot can't be booked twice, and days off appear closed.
landing.aboutImg1: A barber preparing the cape for a seated customer
landing.aboutImg2: A stylist cutting hair with scissors and a comb
landing.audienceText: Services belong to each stylist, so everyone in a shop can work with their own list.
landing.audience1Text: Set up haircuts, clipper cuts and fades with their duration and price.
landing.audience1Alt: A barber tidying a customer's neckline with clippers
landing.audience2Text: Keep cuts, colour and blow-drys of different lengths on the same calendar.
landing.audience2Alt: A stylist cutting a customer's wet hair with scissors
landing.audience3Text: Offer shaves and grooming as separate services so customers choose what they want.
landing.audience3Alt: A straight razor in a barber's hand
landing.featuresText: Your daily work in one panel, from bookings to reports.
landing.feature4Text: Set hours day by day for each stylist. Appointments can't be booked during time off.
landing.feature5Text: Customers are told in the app when an appointment is confirmed or changed.
landing.feature6Text: Customers rate stylists. The best ones are listed on this page.
landing.stepsText: Customers reach you in a few taps in the mobile app.
landing.step1Text: The customer picks their city and district.
landing.step2Text: They choose a shop and the stylist they want.
landing.step3Text: They pick a service and one of the free times.
landing.step4Text: They follow the appointment and rate it afterwards.
landing.galleryText: Sample photos showing different sides of the profession.
landing.footerAbout: A booking platform for salons and barbers. Businesses manage from the web panel, customers book in the mobile app.

register.asideTitle: Manage your bookings from one panel
register.asideText: Fill in the form and an administrator will review your application. Once approved, you can sign in to your panel and add your stylists and services.
register.asidePoint1: Customers find you by choosing a city and district.
register.asidePoint2: Free times are worked out automatically, and confirmation stays with you.
register.asidePoint3: You can start on the free plan.
